title: An Effortless Day
caption:
An Effortless Day

Some days, I want the eyes to lead.
Or I want the look to feel effortless.
On those days, I keep the lips simple: just a gloss, or something clear.

The lips still look like your own,
but not quite bare.
There is a quiet sense of makeup,
and they look soft, hydrated and healthy.

On a relaxed, effortless day,
gloss alone can be just right.
